caption:
Chef Momo spends long shifts leaning over the bench, and by the end of service her back feels stiff.

Holding one position for hours can leave your back doing all the work. Changing position often and building strength can help you get through a busy service.

Hybi's kitchen tips: rest one foot on a low step and swap, bend from the hips to reach down, and fit in a few calf raises. Clinical Pilates can help build trunk and hip strength for long days on your feet.

Pain spreading down a leg or numbness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios run clinical Pilates and can help. Book online via the link in bio
